semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Conprofe Technology Group specializes in CNC machine tools and precision manufacturing, which are relevant to semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Conprofe Technology Group Co., Ltd. specializes in the innovation and manufacturing of high-end ultrasonic-green CNC machine tools and key units, serving various precision manufacturing sectors including semiconductors. The company focuses on efficient, green, and intelligent manufacturing, providing advanced machinery that supports semiconductor production.

regional_presence.China: Headquartered in Guangzhou Science City with sales and service centers established in seven regions.
